title: The moving key
starting_code:
# This is yesterday's program, but the key has moved!
wizard.move_left(4)
wizard.pick_up()
wizard.move_right(4)
wizard.give(key)
hints: First, ask the key for its `distance_to` you. Keep that number under a name, a variable.
Put your new variable inside the brackets of the `move_left` method.
Use the same variable in the `move_right` method to walk the exact same distance back.
intro: The key to Eldra's little room is never twice in the same place! I think she moves it. Yesterday's program walked four steps, but today the key is somewhere else. Make your program ask the key how far it is, keep that number under a name, and use it to walk there and back.
outro: Perfect! Your program works no matter where Eldra leaves the key.
learned: Now you know what a variable is for: a value the program cannot know when it is written, kept under a name and used twice.
